chunks: Mu'awiyah ibn Hukaym narrated from 'Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Zayd, from Mushma'il, from Abu Basir, who said:

I asked Abu Ja'far عليه السلام about a woman who died and left her husband, and she had no heir besides him. He said: "If there is no one besides him, then the property belongs to him; and the woman has one-fourth, and whatever remains belongs to the Imam."

key_terms.الْمَالُ: the estate or property left behind
key_terms.فَلِلْإِمَامِ: the remainder belongs to the Imam as the rightful authority
key_terms.وَارِثَ: an heir entitled to inherit from the deceased

ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance ruling when a spouse dies and there are no other heirs?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on inheritance between spouses when no other heir is present. It states that if a woman dies leaving only her husband, he takes the whole estate, whereas if the deceased is a husband, the wife receives one-fourth and the remainder goes to the Imam.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5612 - Mu'awiyah ibn Hakeem narrated from Ali ibn Al-Hasan ibn Zayd from Mushma'il from Abu Basir who said:

I asked Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) about a woman who passed away and left behind her husband with no other heirs.
Imam (as) said: "If there are no other heirs, the wealth belongs to him. For a woman, she receives one-fourth, and whatever remains belongs to the Imam (as)."
